gen.rule.fire.insulation_class.title: Envelope insulation fire class
gen.rule.fire.insulation_class.desc: Worst reaction-to-fire class the insulation of exterior walls and roofs may have; build-ups with a worse insulation are not chosen.
gen.rule.envelope.u_wall.title: Exterior wall U-value
gen.rule.envelope.u_wall.desc: Highest heat transmittance of an exterior wall; the wall insulation is sized to stay under it, so a colder climate gets a thicker wall.
gen.rule.envelope.u_roof.title: Roof U-value
gen.rule.envelope.u_roof.desc: Highest heat transmittance of a roof; the roof insulation is sized to stay under it.
gen.rule.envelope.u_ground.title: Ground slab U-value
gen.rule.envelope.u_ground.desc: Highest heat transmittance of the floor slab on the ground; the insulation under the screed is sized to stay under it.
gen.rule.acoustic.rw_party.title: Party wall sound insulation
gen.rule.acoustic.rw_party.desc: Least sound reduction index Rw of a wall between dwellings or next to a common corridor; the masonry core is sized by the mass law to reach it.
gen.rule.acoustic.rw_floor.title: Floor sound insulation
gen.rule.acoustic.rw_floor.desc: Least sound reduction index Rw of a floor between storeys; the concrete slab is sized by the mass law to reach it.
